newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel diffs firm enough to offset NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel diffs firm enough to offset NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials firmed enough on Friday to easily offset slight heating oil prices on the NYMEX, where bearish sentiment surrounding crude oil took center stage, traders said.

Activity was moderately active, with deals heard done in New York Harbor (NYH) and at the U.S. Gulf Coast amid views diffs were firmer both in response to the NYMEX losses and due to a late-season pinch in middle distillate supplies.
Airline-quality 54-grade and low sulphur 55-grade closed in NYH about 0.50 cent firmer at 3.85 and 4.30 cents over May NYMEX respectively.
At the USG, 54-grade traded about 0.25 cent firmer at 1.25 cents over the May print, traders said.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
